data.title: The Log Parser (Puzzle Solo)
data.solution:
import re
import sys
codes = {
    "FAT":"FATAL",
    "ERR":"ERROR",
    "WAR":"WARNING",
    "INF":"INFO",
    "DEB":"DEBUG"
}

lvl = int(input())
n = int(input())
for i in range(n):
    line = input()
    code = re.search(r'\> *(\w+) *:', line).group(1)[:3].upper()
    if code in codes.keys() and list(codes.keys()).index(code) <= lvl:
        line = re.sub(r'(?<=\> )(\w+)(?= *:)', codes[code], line)
        print(line)

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You must create a script which can extract logs based on their log level:
FATAL is level 0
ERROR is level 1
WARNING is level 2
INFO is level 3
DEBUG is level 4

Attention: Depending on the application, the log level may be written with difference capitalization or just include the first 3 letters (e.g ERR instead of ERROR). You shall nevertheless display the full log level in uppercase in the result.

FATAL is more important than ERROR, ERROR more than WARNING, etc.
Input
Line 1: loglvl (integer)
Line 2: number n of log lines
Next n Lines: Log line
Output
Every line with a level equal or more important than loglvl.
Constraints
Every log line contains a log level keyword
Example
Input
2
2
<Easyone> FATAL: could not start Easyone software. Verify connectivity
<Easyone> DEBUG: 239 1239 122 1
Output
<Easyone> FATAL: could not start Easyone software. Verify connectivity
